title: Little Lenny and the Big Ocean Problem

productionTargets.reader: interactive scene sequence with one original illustration per source page
productionTargets.video: 16:9 cinematic sequence with camera movement, restrained character/environment animation, narration, and sound design
productionTargets.youtube: render a finished MP4 locally or in a production pipeline; publishing/upload remains a separate explicit action

shots.title: Arrival at the shore
shots.visualDirection: Wide establishing view from behind the family as Lenny and Dad arrive at a sunlit beach; rolling surf, distant beachgoers, footprints and a clear horizon.
shots.performance: Slow cinematic push toward Lenny; waves break and recede; beachgoers shift naturally in the distance.

shots.title: A little game in the sand
shots.visualDirection: Low child-height view of Lenny digging holes with his bucket and shovel while Dad is visible farther down the beach picking something up.
shots.performance: Lenny scoops sand and turns toward the water; bucket water sloshes; Dad bends to retrieve an object.

shots.title: The curious run
shots.visualDirection: Tracking view beside Lenny as he runs toward Dad, water spilling from his bucket.
shots.performance: Camera tracks with Lenny; his steps kick up sand and the bucket swings with believable weight.

shots.title: What did you find?
shots.visualDirection: Medium two-shot: Dad smiles and holds up a discarded plastic bottle; Lenny looks from Dad to the bottle.
shots.performance: Dad raises the bottle into view; Lenny slows, catches his breath, and tilts his head.

shots.title: A beach that looks fine
shots.visualDirection: Wider composition showing ordinary beach activity around the pair; Lenny scans the shoreline while Dad explains.
shots.performance: Camera eases outward to reveal the setting; waves and people continue in gentle background motion.

shots.title: The ocean is connected
shots.visualDirection: Quiet over-the-shoulder view of Dad and Lenny looking out to sea; the water and distant marine life are the visual focus.
shots.performance: A slow pan follows their gaze toward the horizon; sunlight glitters on moving water.

shots.title: Lenny decides to help
shots.visualDirection: Lenny looks toward the water, then turns with determination and spots litter nearby; Dad opens the small bag.
shots.performance: Lenny springs into action; Dad steadies the bag; keep the action readable, not frantic.

shots.title: A small clean patch
shots.visualDirection: A modest section of sand now clean; Lenny stands proudly beside Dad, with the wider beach still extending beyond them.
shots.performance: Gentle camera rise reveals the limited area they cleaned; Lenny's proud posture settles.

shots.title: The next day
shots.visualDirection: Echo the earlier establishing beach view, but now more crowded; Lenny and his family enter the frame.
shots.performance: Camera glides with the family toward the sand; beachgoers recline, sit up, gesture, surf and build sandcastles.

shots.title: The beach has changed
shots.visualDirection: Lenny stops as the camera reveals litter scattered across the busy beach; keep every item grounded in the manuscript's generic description.
shots.performance: A measured reveal: foreground litter, then wider beach, then Lenny's stunned reaction; waves keep rolling.

shots.title: Too much to fix
shots.visualDirection: Lenny sits in the sand with bucket and shovel dropped beside him; Dad kneels at his level.
shots.performance: Lenny's shoulders lower; Dad moves into a kneel and leans closer; background life continues softly.

shots.title: One small effort matters
shots.visualDirection: Intimate two-shot of Dad's arm around Lenny as they look toward the beach.
shots.performance: Dad rests his arm around Lenny; Lenny looks up, then follows Dad's gaze toward the beach.

shots.title: A new idea
shots.visualDirection: Lenny rises with renewed energy and gestures toward the beachgoers; Dad turns to follow.
shots.performance: Lenny springs upright and points; Dad stands and starts after him.

shots.title: Across the busy beach
shots.visualDirection: Wide lively shot: Lenny hurries between a sunbather's towel and children building a sandcastle; Dad follows.
shots.performance: Tracking camera follows Lenny; towel sunbather lifts her head, children keep shaping sand, Dad gestures an apology.

shots.title: Please listen
shots.visualDirection: Lenny stands before a small group holding up the bottle; the listeners look toward him.
shots.performance: Lenny speaks with earnest hand gestures; listeners nod politely and exchange glances.

shots.title: Not everyone listens
shots.visualDirection: A woman sunbathing on a bright towel turns and shushes Lenny; keep her ordinary and human, not villainous.
shots.performance: She raises one finger gently; Lenny's expression falls and his gesture stops.

shots.title: The crowd carries on
shots.visualDirection: Lenny stands small in the foreground while surfers, picnickers and sandcastle builders continue in the background.
shots.performance: The camera slowly pulls back; beachgoers keep subtle natural movement while Lenny becomes still.

shots.title: Defeated
shots.visualDirection: Close, quiet view of Lenny dropping the bottle and sitting with his gaze lowered.
shots.performance: Bottle lands softly in the sand; Lenny folds inward; hold the shot without melodrama.

shots.title: Dad comes beside him
shots.visualDirection: Dad walks into frame and kneels next to Lenny at eye level.
shots.performance: Dad's approach is unhurried; he kneels and speaks gently; Lenny remains looking down.

shots.title: A hand on his shoulder
shots.visualDirection: Close two-shot focused on Dad's hand resting on Lenny's shoulder as they sit together.
shots.performance: Dad's hand settles reassuringly; Lenny glances up briefly; ocean moves in soft focus behind them.

shots.title: The first surprise
shots.visualDirection: A single aluminum can arcs into frame and lands beside them on the sand.
shots.performance: The can bounces once and rolls to a stop; Lenny picks it up without lifting his head much.

shots.title: More appears
shots.visualDirection: A second can and several bottles drop into the sand; Lenny and Dad turn toward the ocean.
shots.performance: Objects enter frame in a short sequence; camera follows their shared turn toward the waterline.

shots.title: A dolphin!
shots.visualDirection: A dolphin's head rises above the surf, framed by rolling waves; Lenny and Dad are visible in the foreground.
shots.performance: Dolphin bobs naturally with the swell; it dives and resurfaces with litter balanced on its head.

shots.title: A helping hand
shots.visualDirection: The dolphin tosses the litter into Lenny's bag; Lenny and Dad laugh and begin gathering nearby litter.
shots.performance: Follow the arc of the tossed item into the bag; cut to the family and dolphin working in rhythm.

shots.title: Too close to the water
shots.visualDirection: Lenny runs toward a floating bottle as the waves draw it away; Dad hurries after him.
shots.performance: Camera tracks toward the waterline; the floating bottle drifts with the current; Dad closes the distance.

shots.title: Just in time
shots.visualDirection: Dad catches Lenny before a breaking wave reaches him and lifts him onto his shoulders; a dolphin looks up from the water.
shots.performance: Wave rises and crashes behind them; Dad's catch is clear and safe; dolphin surfaces beside them.

shots.title: Pulled by the current
shots.visualDirection: Lenny and Dad point excitedly toward the dolphin as the water swirls around them and carries them outward.
shots.performance: The camera rotates gently with the current; foam and bubbles sweep past without disorienting cuts.

shots.title: A safe bubble
shots.visualDirection: Underwater wide shot: a pod of dolphins surrounds a clear air bubble containing Lenny and Dad.
shots.performance: The pod swims in coordinated arcs; bubble shimmers; Lenny and Dad settle as they realize they can breathe.

shots.title: The ocean floor
shots.visualDirection: The pod guides them down to the seabed, where piles of trash interrupt the natural landscape.
shots.performance: Camera descends with the group; suspended particles drift; show environmental harm without graphic imagery.

shots.title: A damaged reef
shots.visualDirection: A coral reef appears with areas of dying coral and litter caught among the structure.
shots.performance: Slow lateral camera move across the reef; fish pass through the scene; keep the damage readable but restrained.

shots.title: Sea turtles
shots.visualDirection: The group passes several sea turtles; some show non-graphic signs of past entanglement or injury.
shots.performance: Turtles swim steadily; dolphins maintain a respectful escort; avoid close-up injury spectacle.

shots.title: A struggling ecosystem
shots.visualDirection: A school of fish moves through a habitat crowded by trash; the fish search for space and food.
shots.performance: Fish school shifts direction together; debris moves subtly with the current; camera widens to show scale.

shots.title: Shared sadness
shots.visualDirection: Lenny and Dad look at the damaged ocean life; the dolphins sense their sadness and stay close.
shots.performance: Lenny's expression softens; Dad draws him close; dolphins slow and circle gently.

shots.title: Back at the shore
shots.visualDirection: The pod returns Lenny and Dad to the familiar beach; Lenny looks at his small bag and asks how they can help.
shots.performance: Camera rises toward the surface and settles at the waterline; Lenny studies the small bag.

shots.title: A dolphin's answer
shots.visualDirection: The dolphin looks into Lenny's eyes, dives, then resurfaces with litter balanced on its nose.
shots.performance: Dolphin dips below the surface and pops back up; hold the beat for Lenny's surprised reaction.

shots.title: A little hope
shots.visualDirection: The dolphin tosses several pieces into Lenny's bag, waves a fin and dives away; Lenny laughs with Dad.
shots.performance: Each piece lands in the bag in sequence; dolphin lifts a fin, then dives; Lenny and Dad share a relieved laugh.

shots.title: Leaving it better
shots.visualDirection: Lenny walks away with the bag over his shoulder, stopping to pick up litter as he goes; Dad walks with him.
shots.performance: Camera follows from behind, then moves alongside their hopeful walk as the surf rolls in.
